en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a natural history museum hall filled with taxidermied animals and skeletons. A tall giraffe mount stands prominently in the center, surrounded by display cases containing seals on artificial rocks, a zebra skeleton, and various other specimens. The walls are decorated with mounted antlers. The scene is clean and formal, with polished floors and glass vitrines. Swedish text is printed at the bottom indicating the mammal hall's foreign section and naming the museum in Gothenburg.
